p: shepherds of Israel that do feed: By the shepherds he means the king, the magistrates, priests and prophets.
fat: You seek to enrich yourselves by their conveniences and to spoil their riches and substance.
diseased ye have not strengthened: He describes the office and duty of a good pastor who ought to love and comfort his flock and not be cruel toward them.
became food to all the beasts: For lack of good government and doctrine they perished.

their mouth: By destroying the covetous hirelings and restoring true shepherds of which we have a sign so often as God sends true preachers, who both by doctrine and life labour to feed his sheep in the pleasant pastures of his word.
the cloudy and dark day: In the day of their affliction and misery: and this promise is to comfort the Church in all dangers.
strong: Meaning such as lift up themselves above their brethren and think they have no need to be governed by me.
judgment: That is, by putting difference between the good and the bad, and so give to either as they deserve.
pasture: By good pasture and deep waters is meant the pure word of God and the administration of justice which they did not distribute to the poor till they had corrupted it.
David: Meaning Christ, of whom David was a figure, See Geneva "Jer 30:9" See Geneva "Ho 3:5"
dwell safely in the wilderness: This declares that under Christ the flock would be truly delivered from sin and hell, and so be safely preserved in the Church where they would never perish.
tree of the field shall yield: The fruit of God's grace will appear in great abundance in his Church.
plant of renown: That is, the rod that will come out of the root of Jesse, Isa 11:1.
